name: Lagerny Psikhdispanser
source:
The pioneer camp simply refuses to release our protagonists from its captivity. This time, Sovyonok has turned out to have another specific feature that messes with our protagonists' minds. At first, it seems that everything is going according to plan, but after a while, all that is hidden comes to light.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1942540165]Steam[/url]]
